detaileddescription.para: /******************************************************************************* void create_xgrid_1dx2d_order1 This routine generate exchange grids between two grids for the first order conservative interpolation. nlon_in,nlat_in,nlon_out,nlat_out are the size of the grid cell and lon_in,lat_in are 1-D grid bounds, lon_out,lat_out are geographic grid location of grid cell bounds.
